item_short_desc: Rothco’s Mini Handcuff Key Ring is a practical accessory for securely organizing your keys. Featuring 2 1-inch manacles, this unique design provides ample space for keys and keychains while adding a law-enforcement-inspired touch. The silver-plated finish enhances durability and gives the key ring a lasting shine. Its compact 2-inch chain makes it easy to attach to belts, bags, or lanyards. Perfect as a gift for law enforcement professionals or anyone who appreciates functional accessories with a twist.
